name: ladder-d-datapath
about: PD4 golden boot -> ONE ordered context-create (g0 id1 key 0x64, type 1) -> read-only MAC slot-5 reachability probe (dp_probe, ONE word) -> dp_setup (allocate TXQ table + 8x64 TX MSDU rings + tx_ba_info + RX 256/512 free rings + 4095 completion ring; write device-RAM MSDU-info table; program+verify MAC band0) -> ONE TXQ-table address sync H2D frame (g0 id1 key 0x0320, 4-byte table devVA) -> post packs. Host-only lane's ladder D (wifi-datapath-bringup, task-111), NOT yet fired at the device.

steps.name: boot-golden
steps.about: LATCHED golden handshake page + state/mask/staging before any H2D message or MAC write

reads.label: cave
reads.about: PD4 stub cave snapshot (captured, expected stub code)

steps.name: catalog-boot
steps.about: D2H catalogue before the H2D pair (baseline for the post-run delta)

steps.name: ctx-create-t1
steps.about: ONE context-create H2D message (g0 id1 key 0x64, type 1) - the ordered precondition of every key-addressed message. No retry.

steps.name: post-create-status
steps.about: the create was committed and the core phase moved ACTIVE (source of the second frame's legality)

steps.name: dp-probe
steps.about: ONE read-only word read of MAC band-0 +0x00. Gate is that the window answered without a bus error (value captured: vendor boot 0x100, a 0/other value is recorded and setup may still run).

steps.name: dp-setup
steps.about: ONE data-plane setup: allocate TXQ table 0x2524 + 8x64x8 TX MSDU rings + tx_ba_info 0x800 + RX free rings 256/512 x 4 B + completion ring 4095 x 4 B + 0x63c/0xb0 buffer pools; write 8 device-RAM MSDU-info table entries {ring devVA,0,0} through ACP; program MAC band0 in vendor order with read-back verify. No retry on failure.

steps.name: dp-setup-status
steps.about: setup completed with all 14 MAC writes verified and all 8 ring-table entries read back

steps.name: dp-rings-check
steps.about: live MAC band-0 register snapshot: RX free-ring producers published full (index 0/phase 1), vendor interrupt mask, and the device-RAM table entries readable

steps.name: pre-txq-status
steps.about: the key-0x0320 hand-off is legal now and has not been sent

steps.name: dp-txq-sync
steps.about: ONE g0 id1 key-0x0320 TXQ-table address sync frame: 32 B frame, data = 4-byte device VA of the 0x2524-byte host TXQ table, through the exact H2D carrier (SR node) + coalesced mailbox id-3 announce + bounded out[0] poll. No retry.

steps.name: post-txq-status
steps.about: the firmware consumed the second announce (no timeout) and the hand-off is recorded

steps.name: post-txq-pack
steps.about: the whole point: mask 0 + staging 0 after the MAC program and the 0x320 frame; page/state still golden; mailbox drains

reads.label: mask2
reads.about: no firmware exception after the data-plane setup / hand-off

steps.name: catalog-after
steps.about: post-run D2H catalogue delta capture (the 0x320 worker has no known D2H answer; this is evidence, not a gate)

steps.name: done-note
steps.about: STOP after this boot. One setup + one hand-off frame per load; do not retry a failed step, do not reload in the same boot (the PD4 cave poll loop is one-shot). Recovery door armed for the whole session.
